info.title: FieldFinder API
info.description: Public read-only search over published soccer venues and pitches, plus the admin API used to curate them. Errors are always `{ code, message, requestId }`. See docs/api/README.md.

tags.name: Public
tags.description: No authentication. Rate limited per IP at the edge.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Bearer token with the listed scope. Rate limited per token and per IP.

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid request: a parameter, header or body field failed validation.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, malformed, expired or revoked admin token.

Forbidden.description: The token is valid but lacks the scope this route needs, or the client IP isn't on its allowlist.

example.message: You don't have access to this resource.

NotFound.description: Not found. Public routes also say this for anything that isn't published.

Conflict.description: If-Match is stale, or the change isn't allowed in the record's current state.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Wait for Retry-After seconds, when given.

example.message: Too many requests. Try again later.

Internal.description: Unexpected server error. Quote the requestId.

example.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

adminToken.description: An `ffadm_…` token minted with `pnpm admin:credential mint` (ADR-0003). Header only: a token in the query string is rejected.

message.description: Safe to show to anyone. Never a stack trace or field value.

requestId.description: Also in the X-Request-Id header. Quote it when reporting a problem.

totalCount.description: Venues matching the search across all pages.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

location.description: The venue's public location, never the searcher's.

href.description: Page to open: the pitch page when the venue has one published pitch, else the venue page.

Amenities.description: Confirmed amenities only. A missing key means "not confirmed", never "no".

url.description: Public image URL. Stops working once the image is unpublished.

attribution.description: Show it wherever the image is shown. Null for images FieldFinder owns.

access.description: The pitch's own rule. Null means it uses the venue's.

effectiveAccess.description: The rule that applies: the pitch's, else the venue's.

get.description: Published venues within `radiusKm` of (`lat`, `lng`), nearest first. Pitch filters (`surface`, `pitchSize`, `lighting`, `access`) must all be met by the same pitch. Coordinates are rounded to 3 decimal places. Unknown or repeated parameters are a 400. Any non-canonical spelling of a valid query (parameter order, default values, extra digits) gets a 308 to the canonical URL; clients should request that form directly.

post.description:
Only the venue goes back to draft. Its pitches keep their status but are hidden while the venue isn't published; pitches that were published become public again when the venue is republished, even if the publish request doesn't list them (unpublish those pitches first to keep them hidden). The public copies of the venue's and its pitches' images are deleted, and the images stay drafts until published again.

Scope: `content:publish`.

get.summary: List images that aren't shown anywhere public
get.description:
Unused images and why (`unusedReason`), computed on every request, so always current: images left on archived or hidden venues and pitches, and draft or archived images. `unused=true` is required; this isn't a general listing. Ordered by id; pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`.

Scope: `media:write`.
